agendaItems.title: Memorandum from Belix Parks, CRA Community Development Coordinator, transmitting the Vincente Ybor Project – 2914 N. Nebraska Avenue Urban ReWorx CRA Housing Funding Agreement. (To be R/F)Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, Florida, approving Urban Reworx, LLC, Grant Funding and Construction Agreement by and between said Community Redevelopment Agency (“CRA”) and Urban Reworx, LLC (“Grant Recipient”) to construct a mixed-use project consisting of 20 units of affordable housing and 950 sf of commercial space generally described as the Vicente Ybor Development at 2914 n. Nebraska Ave, Tampa, FL 33602 on property located within the boundaries of the East Tampa Community Redevelopment Area; authorizing execution of the Community Redevelopment Grant Funding Agreement by the Chair of the CRA and attestation by the CRA Secretary; providing an effective date.
